title: Claiming the Best of the Land by Faith
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner declares that the best of the land is reserved for those who believe, and shares a compelling vision for The River Church's future as a launching pad for global revival. With a focus on faith, inheritance, and the supernatural provision of God, Pastor Zehner inspires listeners to step into their identity as joint heirs with Christ and claim the promises of God in their lives. Join us as we listen in on this energetic and encouraging message that will leave you feeling empowered and eager to take hold of God's blessings.
